dialect.label: Mitsubishi M700/M70, M2/M0 format
dialect.about: Mitsubishi's own program format, picked by a parameter instead of the Fanuc-like format: G22 L calls a subprogram and G23 returns, G44 cancels the tool length, G62 is mirror image.

source.manual: Mitsubishi M700/M70 Series Programming Manual, M2/M0 format
source.section: G code list and subprograms (section 13.3.1); see docs/manual-reviews/mitsubishi-m800-m700.md

G49.text: The M2/M0 format has no G49: G44 cancels the tool length.

M98.text: In the M2/M0 format a subprogram is called with G22 L (program) P (repeats), not M98.

M99.text: In the M2/M0 format a subprogram returns with G23, not M99.

G22.desc: Call a subprogram: L the program, P the repeat count (M2/M0 format)

G44.desc: Tool length offset cancel (M2/M0 format; there's no G49)
